decisions.reason: ISBN placement on the copyright page does not alter the content or formatting of the separate dedication page.
The source specifies content placement on one front-matter page and does not change the general interior trim size, spacing, or page-density rules.
Placing the ISBN on the copyright page does not affect chapter illustrations, their placement, size, or rendering quality.
The copyright page and interior title page are distinct pages, and the source does not change the title-page arrangement.
The ISBN placement request does not change interior page numbering or Table of Contents behavior.
The source does not affect chapter-title or subtitle formatting.
ISBN placement on the copyright page does not affect the typography of recurring Mama's Hot Take callouts.
The source does not change book-title typography or the prohibition on literal newline artifacts.
The client specifically requests ISBN placement on the copyright page and does not add, remove, or modify any cover requirement.
The copyright page is front matter, and the request does not modify back-matter or author-copy content.
The physical placement of an ISBN in the manuscript does not change the existing KDP keyword-document deliverable or its delivery method.
Adding the ISBN to the copyright page does not modify the manuscript prose or the established copyediting rules.
